2608.23435.title: Towards Comprehensive Basketball Understanding
2608.23435.paper_summary: Understanding a basketball game requires recognizing events, localizing actions, identifying players, and relating these to structured game knowledge. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate these abilities one at a time, leaving the interactions among these abilities under-explored. We introduce BasketballBench, a multimodal benchmark comprising 7,980 questions across ten tasks in text, image, and video. It is built from the 2025-2026 NBA season and includes official playby-play, rosters and profiles for 530 active players, and 2,501 possession-level broadcast clips. We further propose BasketballSkills, an agent that composes eight basketball-specific perception and retrieval tools under four reusable skills that specify tool order, evidence bindings, and stopping conditions. Experiments show that current MLLMs struggle particularly on questions requiring the integration of multiple capabilities, whereas BasketballSkills outperforms them, highlighting the effectiveness of explicitly composing domain-specific capabilities for comprehensive basketball understanding.
2608.23435.paper_summary_zh: 理解籃球比賽需要識別事件、定位動作、識別球員，並將這些與結構化的比賽知識相關聯。現有的基準主要一次評估這些能力中的一項，導致這些能力之間的互動未被充分探索。我們介紹了BasketballBench，這是一個多模態基準，包含跨越十個任務的7,980個問題，涵蓋文本、圖像和視頻。它是基於2025-2026 NBA賽季建立的，並包括官方的逐球記錄、530名活躍球員的名單和簡介，以及2,501個擁有級別的廣播片段。我們進一步提出了BasketballSkills，一個組合了八個籃球特定感知和檢索工具的代理，這些工具在四個可重用的技能下指定工具順序、證據綁定和停止條件。實驗顯示，目前的MLLM在需要整合多種能力的問題上特別掙扎，而BasketballSkills的表現超過了它們，突顯了明確組合領域特定能力以實現全面籃球理解的有效性。
